Building a structure requires material in two separate phases: first setting up the construction site (a fixed amount of sticks per microcell the building occupies), then the actual construction, which will require its own materials in the future.

Right now the game never creates a Task on its own to fetch this material: if it's missing, the site simply waits. You have to bring it there yourself, by manually commanding an individual (gather the material and deposit it at the site).

One exception: the very first Deposit Site you build, while the village has no other building with real storage space yet, gets its setup material for free, so you can always get started even with no stock.
This manual supply will be needed until you unlock the future Task management and warehouse management systems - from that point on, the game will be able to handle it on its own.
